ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure is the settlement density map of Jilin Province in 1820, and on the right side is the settlement density map of Jilin Province in 1990; the legend shows that settlement density is divided into 0—5, 5—20, 20—40, and 40—60 units/100km². Comparing the two maps, it can be seen that in 1990, compared with 1820, the high-density and relatively high-density areas increased significantly and their ranges expanded, indicating that the number of settlements and the density degree of distribution rose significantly. Then reason: the question restricts the inquiry to "the factor in terms of agricultural production." The increase in settlement density is related to the improvement of agricultural production conditions and the raising of the level of agricultural development, so the most direct factor in terms of agricultural production is agricultural development.
